sentences.en: Mother advised me to take a walk for a change.
sentences.zh: 妈妈建议我出去散散步换换心情。

sentences.en: We wish to advise you of the following price reductions.
sentences.zh: 我们想通知您以下的价格优惠。

sentences.en: The doctor advised Mr White not to smoke too much.
sentences.zh: 医生建议怀特先生不要太抽烟。
